# Public sector and regulated security

## Scope

Applies when the change touches government or audited systems. Not when no government buyer, audit regime, or public-sector law applies. Neighbours: `aidd-team:enterprise-controls`, `aidd-team:accessible-ui`, `aidd-team:privacy-by-default`.

## Standards

| # | Standard | Edition | Checked | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| S1 | NIST CSF | 2.0 | 2026-09-29 | <https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/cswp/29/the-nist-cybersecurity-framework-csf-20/final> |
| S2 | NIST SP 800-53 | Rev. 5, Release 5.2.0 | 2026-09-29 | <https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/53/r5/upd1/final> |
| S3 | FedRAMP Rev. 5 baselines, where they apply | Rev. 5 | 2026-09-30 | <https://www.fedramp.gov/legacy/> |
| S4 | FedRAMP 20x | Consolidated Rules for 2026 | 2026-09-30 | <https://www.fedramp.gov/20x/> |
| S5 | FIPS 140-3 cryptography | FIPS 140-3 | 2026-09-29 | <https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/140-3/final> |
| S6 | NIST post-quantum standards (FIPS 203, 204, 205) for new cryptography | FIPS 203, FIPS 204, FIPS 205 | 2026-09-29 | <https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/203/final> |
| S7 | NIST Privacy Framework where a US privacy-programme mapping is needed | Version 1.0 | 2026-09-30 | <https://www.nist.gov/privacy-framework> |
| S8 | CycloneDX cryptography bill of materials (CBOM) | 1.7.2 | 2026-09-29 | <https://github.com/CycloneDX/specification/releases/tag/1.7.2> |

## Dated obligations

| From | Obligation | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2027-06-11 | FedRAMP stops accepting new Rev. 5 certifications; a new authorization follows the Consolidated Rules for 2026. | S3, S4 |
| 2028-12-31 | Existing Rev. 5 certifications remain active until at least this date, unless FedRAMP is otherwise directed. | S3 |

## Checklist by loop step

| Step | Item | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Entry (`aidd assess`) | Government or audited systems: the compliance dimension, major, evidence retained for the audit. | S1 |
| Specify | Map the change to the NIST SP 800-53 controls it touches, and to the NIST Privacy Framework where a US privacy programme needs the mapping. | S2, S7 |
| Specify | FIPS-validated cryptography named for any crypto change; new cryptography chosen with the post-quantum standards (FIPS 203, 204, 205) in view. | S5, S6 |
| Implement | Logging and audit trails per the control baseline; no new cryptography outside the validated modules. | S2, S5 |
| Review | Control mapping and evidence complete; the POA&M updated for any accepted risk. | S2, S3, S4 |
| Ship | Continuous-monitoring signals watched; the change record retained with the gate record. | S1, S4 |

## Test commands

| Command | Proves | How | Standard |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Control mapping | the touched controls are named and reviewed | OSCAL (v1.2.3) component definitions and the SSP, validated with compliance-trestle (`uvx --from compliance-trestle==5.1.0 trestle validate -a`), or the team's control matrix | S2 |
| Cryptography inventory | only FIPS 140-3 validated modules, and every algorithm listed for the post-quantum move | a CBOM (CycloneDX cryptographic assets) from the code, such as the CBOMkit sonar-cryptography plugin (1.7.0), checked against the allowed modules and algorithms | S5, S6, S8 |
| Audit log tests | every privileged action is logged with actor, time, and outcome | integration tests | S2 |

- From `aidd-team:enterprise-controls`: Dependency scan, Static analysis, Container scan and SBOM.
- From `aidd-team:accessible-ui`: Accessibility per state.

## Keep it current

Each entry is due after its `review_every_days` (else emerging 90 days, established 365) or by its `review_due`. An emerging one applies only when the change needs it, said in the Spec. One `aidd eval standards` lists as due is looked up in Specify, and a missing one is proposed to aidd's `schemas/roles.json`. Steward: @thaithienvanid, who reviews every change to this pack's standards.
